destinationsScraped.name: Bhimbetka
destinationsScraped.summary: Prehistoric rock shelters in the forested Vindhyan hills ~45 km SE of Bhopal (Raisen district). 760 shelters, ~500 with rock paintings, the oldest dating back tens of thousands of years (Mesolithic onward; some cupules in the Auditorium Cave far older). UNESCO World Heritage Site (inscribed 2003). Named shelters: Auditorium Rock, Zoo Rock (most densely painted, Mesolithic), Boar Rock, Turtle Rock. Often combined with the nearby Bhojpur Shiva temple (~7.5 ft linga), ~45-50 min away.
destinationsScraped.access: Rail: Bhopal Junction / Obedullaganj (~7 km). Air: Raja Bhoj Airport, Bhopal. Road: ~1-1.5 hr by car from Bhopal via NH46 (Hoshangabad road).
destinationsScraped.notesFromSite: Site page did not give exact timings/fees; ASI site, generally sunrise-sunset, small entry fee.

destinationsScraped.name: Bhedaghat
destinationsScraped.summary: The Marble Rocks gorge on the Narmada near Jabalpur (~20 km): white/cream marble (dolomitic limestone) cliffs rising ~30 m, best seen by boat, and famously on a full-moon night when the marble glows. Dhuandhar ('smoke cascade') Falls where the Narmada plunges in a roaring mist; a ropeway crosses the gorge at the falls. The 10th-century Chausath Yogini temple on a hilltop above the river. 'Bandar Kudni' is the narrowest point. Marble here has been quarried and carved for generations.
destinationsScraped.access: Rail/Air: Jabalpur (~20-25 km). Road: ~30-40 min from Jabalpur.
destinationsScraped.safetyFromSite: In the monsoon the falls thunder at their most powerful; boating in the gorge is suspended when the river is high (monsoon and just after) for safety.

destinationsScraped.name: Omkareshwar
destinationsScraped.summary: Om-shaped island (Mandhata) in the Narmada ~80 km from Indore, Khandwa dist. Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga (1 of 12); linked Mamleshwar temple on the south bank; Gauri Somnath (11th c.), Siddhnath (13th c.), 24 Avatars; island parikrama ~7 km; 270-ft hanging footbridge; Kotitirtha ghat evening aarti; 108-ft Adi Shankaracharya 'Statue of Oneness' installed Sep 2023 (Ekatma Dham). Rail: Omkareshwar Road (Mortakka ~12 km) / Khandwa ~72 km / Indore ~78 km. Air: Indore ~87 km. Best Oct-Mar.

destinationsScraped.name: Maheshwar
destinationsScraped.summary: Narmada-bank town, Khargone dist., ~90 km from Indore, ~40 km from Mandu. 18th-c. capital of Ahilyabai Holkar: Ahilya Fort + Rajwada palace; carved sandstone ghats with chhatris + evening aarti; Baneshwar temple on a river rock; centuries-old handloom centre for the Maheshwari saree (Rehwa Society in the fort). Ahilya Fort heritage hotel + MP Tourism Narmada Retreat. Nearest rail Barwaha ~40 km / Indore. Best Oct-Mar; summer to ~46 C.
